record_hint: Use the MCP tools dashboard_record_decision, dashboard_record_impression, dashboard_record_vision_review, dashboard_record_reconcile, dashboard_record_read, dashboard_record_insight and dashboard_record_song_receipt (or `python -m dashboard record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with dashboard_records_search / dashboard_records_digest.
